title: Company profile

export.title: Data export (GDPR)
export.description: Export all of your tenant's data as a ZIP archive (machine-readable JSON per table plus the associated original files). GDPR-compliant (Art. 20 – data portability). Available to the owner only.

frozenNote: These details are frozen when an invoice is finalized (§14 UStG). A compliant invoice cannot be finalized without a complete profile.
